children: Raymond shares are likely to remain in focus in trade on Tuesday after the company said its subsidiary has won multi-programme aerospace orders from a leading Indian aerospace and defence major.
The company made the announcement after market hours on Friday. With the markets closed on Monday, the company's shares are likely to remain in focus on Tuesday.

In an exchange filing, the company said the programmes span precision machining, aerospace castings, structural components and complex assemblies, with an annual business potential of approximately Rs 33 crore.

Commenting on the development, Rakesh Tiwary, Group Chief Financial Officer, Raymond Ltd, said the order win is aligned with the company's product mix optimisation strategy and will strengthen its multi-year aerospace order pipeline.

He said the award win reaffirms Raymond's manufacturing capabilities across machining, castings, structures and assemblies, rather than at a single stage of the value chain. This raises the company's capture rate per programme and improves the quality of its multi-year backlog, he added.
The orders also broaden the company's customer base into India's domestic aerospace ecosystem, a business that has so far been predominantly export-led, Tiwary said.

He added that the new orders further strengthen the company's multi-year aerospace order pipeline and reinforce its strategy of building a scaled, high-precision aerospace and defence manufacturing platform in India.
Shares of Raymond settled more than 17 percent higher at Rs 1,002.80 per share on the NSE in Friday's trade.

title: Raymond shares to remain in focus as aerospace arm wins orders
